{{Top}}
A '''stylus''' was a device used for writing. One such way of using it was by etching the writing into a material. One specific stylus in [[3000 BBY]] was made of [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]].

Using a stylus was one of the methods through which a user could input data into a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
